newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: J.Martins denies interest in Centralcer.
newsitem.headline: J.Martins denies interest in Centralcer.

text.p: Portuguese retailer Jeronimo Martins denied a press report that it was interested in acquiring drinks company Centralcer, but admitted that it had previously considered the matter.
"Jeronimo Martins denies any interest in acquiring Centralcer," Jorge Ponce de Leao, a director of the group, said.
"There were talks six months ago, but the issue died completely," he told Reuters.

Diario Economico newspaper reported today that Jeronimo Martins had made a verbal offer to buy Centralcer at the end of last year and that the group was still considering the possibility of acquiring it.
